units.source_text: 山路变得弯弯曲曲，快到天城岭了。

en.t: The mountain road grew winding, and I was nearly at Amagi Pass.

units.source_text: 这时，骤雨白亮亮地笼罩着茂密的杉林，从山麓向我迅猛地横扫过来。

en.t: Just then, a sudden shower, bright white, enveloped the dense cedar forest and swept fiercely toward me from the foot of the mountain.
